newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - July 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - July 24.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - President Lee Teng-hui says cabinet reshuffle will be completed on August 30.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Taiwan vows to take "drastic measures" if Cambodia insists on closing down Taipei's unofficial representative office in Phnom Penh.

Peng Ming-min, Taiwan independence activist and former presidential nominee, says his party, Democratic Progressive Party, abandoned ideals while negotiating with ruling Nationalist Party on Constitutional reforms.
LIBERTY TIMES - Taiwan says Cambodia's demand for shutdown of Taipei rep office in Phnom Penh "ridiculous".
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan June jobless rate at 2.67 percent.
U.S., European stock markets boosted by Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's upbeat remarks on economy.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Vice President Lien Chan says stock market "healthy".
Asian central banks may launch joint effort to calm recent currency crisis.
